name: Kuze Kasumi
source:
Flaw: His behavior is incomprehensible

‘So, how about it?
Since something’s troubling you, why don’t you let me help you out?’

1st year high-school student. [url=/c42611]Madoka’s[/url] younger twin brother. Though he was a modelling prodigy, he suddenly began to crossdress one day, and stopped accepting modelling jobs. Enjoys the fact that he is able to seduce people with his charisma and the mysterious atmosphere that surrounds him.

[From [url=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2016/01/17/blackish-house-introduction-2/]Rie's Otoge Blog[/url]]
